import json, random, sys, collections
sys.path.insert(0, '/app/work'); sys.path.insert(0, '/app/submission')
import ref as R, main as M

def build(rng):
    C = rng.choice([2, 3])
    W = rng.choice([1, 2, 3])
    svc = [rng.choice([1, 2, 500, 1000]) for _ in range(C)]
    model = {"classes": C, "embedding_dim": 1,
             "length_embedding": [[i] for i in range(16)],
             "gap_embedding": [[0] for _ in range(16)],
             "kernel": 1, "conv_weights": [[[1, 0]] for _ in range(1)],
             "conv_bias": [0], "conv_shift": [0],
             "dense_weights": [[0] for _ in range(C)],
             "dense_bias": [0] * C}
    # prediction = index of largest embedding value among classes -> make class c fire
    # use dense weight 1 on the single filter for classes 1..C-1, 0 for class 0
    model["dense_weights"] = [[0]] + [[1]] * (C - 1)
    cfg = {"slots": 1, "window": W, "idle_timeout": 10**12,
           "len_quantum": 1, "gap_quantum": 1, "rate_num": 10**6, "rate_den": 1,
           "bucket_capacity": 512, "initial_tokens": 512, "pending_capacity": 512,
           "lanes": rng.randint(1, 4), "service": svc, "fallback": 0,
           "time_edges": [0], "count_edges": [0], "probability": [[65536]]}
    conns = [{"id": "x", "slot": 0, "label": 0, "split": "dev"}]
    pkts = []
    t = 0
    for i in range(rng.randint(20, 200)):
        t += rng.choice([0, 1, 1, 2, 3])
        pkts.append({"time": t, "connection": "x", "length": rng.randrange(16), "draw": 0})
    return {"version": 1, "config": cfg, "model": model, "connections": conns, "packets": pkts}

stat = collections.Counter(); mism = 0
for it in range(400):
    rng = random.Random(60600 + it)
    doc = build(rng)
    text = json.dumps(doc)
    root = json.loads(text, object_pairs_hook=M._hook_pairs, parse_float=M._reject_float, parse_constant=M._reject_constant)
    st = M.validate(root)
    mine = M.replay(st); theirs = R.replay(st)
    if mine != theirs:
        mism += 1
        print("MISMATCH", it); open('/app/work/fail_sup.json','w').write(text)
        break
    for j in mine["jobs"]: stat[j["status"]] += 1
print("statuses:", dict(stat), "mismatches:", mism)
PYEOF
cd /app/work && python3 sup_fuzz.py
